items.name: Rowdy's Sling-Bracer
items.lore: Every rowdy in Connacht carries a sling. Colm's was the worst-made. He's proud of it.

items.name: Hearthstone Ring
items.lore: A pebble from Aine's hearth, set in tin.

items.name: Brothers' Cord
items.lore: Two cords plaited together. Brothers in Connacht trade them.

items.name: Aine's Shawl
items.lore: A blue shawl, darned many times by a mother who sat up waiting.

items.name: Wicker-Ash Charm
items.lore: Ash from a wicker man that never burned its captive.

items.name: Azure Robe-Clasp
items.lore: The clasp of an Azure Order robe. Ronan kept his.

items.name: Champion's Ring
items.lore: Fiachra's own. The Champions of Connacht give them for valour.

items.name: Patrol-Spear Bracer
items.lore: The haft of a patrol's spear, cut down and bound.
